reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text: I bought this after seeing it recommended by a skincare blogger because I've been struggling with visible sebaceous filaments on my nose lately. My skin is combination, and the nose area gets especially oily, so I wanted something gentle to help with pore care. I'm really happy with this product. Instead of feeling harsh like traditional pore strips, it softens the sebum and makes it much easier to remove. My nose felt noticeably smoother after using it, and my pores looked much cleaner without feeling irritated or stripped. I also like that it doesn't leave my skin dry afterward. The results aren't permanent, so I'll definitely keep using it regularly as part of my routine
reviews.zh: 因為近排鼻上有明顯嘅皮脂管絲，所以睇到有護膚博主推薦就買咗呢件產品。我屬於混合性肌，鼻位特別油，想搵啲溫和嘅產品幫手護理毛孔。對呢件產品真係好滿意。比起傳統毛孔貼，佢唔會咁刺激，反而會軟化油脂，令污垢更容易清走。用完之後鼻明顯滑咗，毛孔望落乾淨好多，但又唔會覺得刺激或者被刮乾。用完之後皮膚都唔會乾。效果唔係永久嘅，所以我一定會持續用落去，作為日常護膚一部份。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text:
Pores look great right after use
Definitely the best nose patch
Although after a day the pores look almost the same as before, but I think it has to do with the rest of the skin care
reviews.zh:
用完即時毛孔望落好好
絕對係最好用嘅鼻貼
不過過咗一日之後，毛孔望落同用之前差唔多，但我覺得同其餘嘅護膚程序都有關

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text: Just used it on my forehead because I have closed comedones and on my nose and the results really shocked me. Now I understand why the second step (the serum sheet) is so important. Love this product, definitely purchase again.
reviews.zh: 因為我有閉口粉刺，所以只係用喺額頭同鼻，效果真係嚇親我。而家明白點解第二步（精華貼）咁重要。好鍾意呢件產品，一定會再買。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text:
I tried the ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch because I struggle with blackheads on my nose, and I was curious to see how it compares to other nose patches. What I liked about this one is that it feels pretty gentle on the skin and doesn't leave my nose feeling irritated afterwards.

After using it, I did notice that some of the blackheads and oil were pulled out, and my pores looked a bit cleaner. It’s also easy to apply and remove, which I appreciate because some patches can be kind of painful to take off.

I wouldn’t say it completely clears everything in one use, but it definitely helps keep the pores on my nose looking cleaner when I use it occasionally. Overall it's a nice quick fix when my pores start looking a bit congested.
reviews.zh:
因為鼻上經常生黑頭，加上想知同其它鼻貼比較有咩分別，所以試咗 ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch。鍾意嘅地方係對皮膚好溫和，用完之後鼻位唔會覺得刺激。

用完之後，確實見到有啲黑頭同油脂被扯出嚟，毛孔望落乾淨咗少少。貼同撕都好容易，呢樣我好感激，因為有啲貼撕落嚟會幾痛。

唔敢講一次用晒所有污垢，但間中用吓，鼻上毛孔的確望落乾淨啲。總體嚟講，當毛孔開始塞嘅時候，係個幾好嘅快速解救方法。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text: I used the nose patches exactly as instructed, and it’s honestly super effective. After applying Step 1, the whiteheads surfaced really quickly, and using the ilso spatula made it easy to remove them before applying Step 2. I’ve tried similar products from other brands, but this one works the best by far. The results are amazing — though definitely too disgusting to show in a photo! I’ll definitely repurchase.
reviews.zh: 我完全跟住指示用呢個鼻貼，真心超級有效。搽完 Step 1 之後白頭好快就浮出嚟，再用 ilso 刮棒就好容易清走，然後再搽 Step 2。試過其它牌子類似嘅產品，但呢個係到目前為止最有效嘅。效果好到不得了——不過真係太核突，唔可以影相俾人睇！一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text: It works, kinda. Might be better for those who have visible whiteheads. And the patch sticks well, but does not cover the tip of the nose. If your whiteheads are mostly on the sides of the nose, then I think it'll work much better for you.
reviews.zh: 算係有用，但只係一般。對有明顯白頭嘅人可能會比較啱。貼嘅貼服度好，但就覆蓋唔到鼻尖。如果你嘅白頭主要集中喺鼻兩側，我覺得會好用好多。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text: This nose pack is AMAZING! All of my white heads showed up on the surface of my nose after I used the first nose mask. It was crazy I never knew my white heads and black heads could do this! I 100% recommend this nose pack and I will definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 呢個鼻貼真係超正！用完第一塊鼻膜之後，所有白頭都浮咗上嚟。好癲，我從來唔知我嘅白頭同黑頭可以做到呢個效果！100% 推薦呢個鼻貼，一定會再回購！

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Clear Nose Patch 5ea
reviews.text: Amazing product to decongest. Melts all sebaceous filaments on my nose and very easy to clean afterwards. Okay to use once in a few weeks. Wish they created more different patch shapes
reviews.zh: 疏通毛孔嘅神奇產品。將鼻上所有皮脂管絲都溶化，用完之後好容易清潔。隔幾星期用一次都仲可以。希望佢哋出多啲唔同形狀嘅貼。
